prompt: For each order channel (store and web) and each month of 2024, how many orders did Voltmarkt take? order_ts holds UTC time: take the month in UTC. Every channel has a row for every month of 2024, and a month with no orders in a channel shows 0. Return three columns, in this order: channel, month (the first day of the month) and orders. Return one row for each channel and month. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per channel and month of 2024

hints: Next, build every channel and month pair, then attach the monthly counts to it.
Pair each channel with each month first; then a pair with no orders still has a row, and its missing count becomes 0.
faded_shape:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024
  SELECT DISTINCT month_start AS month
  FROM calendar
  WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
), channels AS (
  -- one row per order channel
  SELECT DISTINCT channel
  FROM orders
), monthly AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with orders
  SELECT channel, CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY channel, CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE)
)
why_this_works: CROSS JOIN pairs every channel with every month, so the grid has all 24 cells; the LEFT JOIN fills them, with 0 where nothing was ordered.
